You asked me to report only what the pages actually say, give a URL for every point and not fill gaps from my own knowledge. Without any pages read, I can't write the notes. Anything I wrote now would come from memory, with no checked sources behind it.

When you're ready for me to try again, I plan to read these pages first:

- **Verse-by-verse:** enduringword.com (Joel 3), biblehub.com (Ellicott, Pulpit Commentary, Gill on Joel 3), preceptaustin.org (Joel 3 commentary) and studylight.org (Wesley's Notes, Matthew Henry and others)
- **Where Protestant traditions differ:** mainly on whether vv. 1–2, 12–17 and 18–21 refer to events already past, the church, or a future end-time judgment and restoration of Israel. Sources would include gty.org, desiringgod.org, ligonier.org, thegospelcoalition.org, wesley.nnu.edu, lcms.org/1517.org and enduringword.com.
- **Other views:** netbible.org's translators' notes, bibleodyssey.org, and Catholic readings (newadvent.org, plus Haydock on studylight.org)
- **Single topics:** gotquestions.org on "Valley of Jehoshaphat" and "valley of decision" (v. 14), and the reversal of "plowshares into swords" (v. 10) compared with Isaiah 2/Micah 4

Just reply "go ahead" and I'll start the fetches and write the notes verse by verse, with a URL after each point.
